The Reality Code Engine (2,221 Checks, 0 Failures · 49 mJ per Check)
Write a program once as one complete state-machine blueprint, check it in 49 millijoules, and emit matching code across languages.
1) You write a program once in one clear blueprint, and the computer generates matching code in many languages.
2) Every possible input must have a declared outcome up front, leaving nowhere for silent crashes to hide.
3) Once a repair passes every check, the engine saves and reuses it so nobody pays twice for one bug.
